name: universal-harness-runtime
comment: Deterministic, auditable runtime pin. Every hash below was obtained from the official checksum source named in checksumSource and is re-verified by `uh setup`/`uh doctor` before any bundled binary is executed. Do not pin a version by tag alone; a pin without a hash is not a pin.

macos-arm64.verificationNote: Code path supported; NOT verified on real Apple Silicon hardware (see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).

linux-arm64.verificationNote: Target added for the Phase 3 Android execution node (bundled arm64 Node inside the PRoot Ubuntu rootfs, glibc >= 2.28). Official nodejs.org distribution; NOT verified on real hardware — R-01 stays unresolved until the TESTING.md 2a real-device gate.

dsh.installNote: Installed by `uh setup` with the bundled Node's npm into runtime/dsh as an exact version pin (never a floating tag). Upstream dsh is used unmodified; Universal Harness only spawns it.
